name: Pre-Approval Removal
description: SLD POSTs a learner onto two short courses in a single bundled OnProgramme payload: ZSC00001 is complete, ZSC00002 is still continuing (no completion or withdrawal date). Neither course is ever approved. SLD then re-POSTs the same payload with ZSC00002 omitted entirely, removing it by omission before it was ever approved.

steps.name: SLD POSTs ZSC00001 (complete) and ZSC00002 (continuing) in a Single Bundled Payload
SLD Re-POSTs ZSC00001 Only — ZSC00002 Omitted
ZSC00002 episode is removed by omission (Learning DB)
ZSC00002 episode is removed by omission (Earnings DB)

assertions.name: 1 non-removed ShortCourseEpisode row in Earnings DB (ZSC00001 only)
